source: issue #770 (integration fan-in brief named raw `git merge --no-edit`, no workit verb)
prompt:
You are worker a of an integration-mode fanout, in the git worktree {{worktree}} (branch feature/wt-a). Your slice is committed and VERIFY passed. The FAN-IN section of your brief reads:

FAN-IN: integration branch feature/usage. Before you report, run `workit git --cwd {{worktree}} rebase --onto feature/usage`
  and re-run VERIFY, so the lead's merge is a fast-forward. A conflict aborts the rebase: report its paths.
  No other rebase, and no merge, retarget, push or force-push.

Do the fan-in step now, then report in one line. Skip re-running VERIFY.

require.why: the fan-in step runs the workit rebase verb onto the integration tip

forbid.why: workit git has no merge subcommand
no raw git merge: the brief's fan-in is a workit verb
